summary: 40 units reviewed. Main errors: u16 wrong split (aiṇa should be eṇa); u25 probable misparse asura-dāru vs sura-dāru (deodar) needing a human decision; u20 and u34 unhedged conjectured readings (puṇḍarīka, ghana, kaṭvaṅga) plus missing identifications beside terms; many minor Hindi/English gloss and hedge fixes (vidārī, parpaṭaka, durālabhā, aśmantaka, uddālaka, jāṅgala, basti). No wrong identification found other than u25. Counts of structures n/a. Units needing a human decision: 4, 9, 18, 25, 31. No regrouping suggested (u30-31 appear to continue, u22-23 fine).
glossary_suggestions: payasyā/aśmantaka/durālabhā: record candidate names (Ipomoea digitata or Pueraria; Bauhinia racemosa; Alhagi or Fagonia) with 'disputed' in every language.
sura-dāru vs asura-dāru: prefer the attested suradāru (devadāru) when a sandhi string allows both.
Regular sandhi (tataḥ + eva > tata eva; yasyāḥ + b > yasyā b) must not be described as a lost visarga in glosses or notes.
uddālaka: probably a wild kodo millet (disputed); Hindi 'सम्भवतः कोदो की कोई किस्म'.
Hindi: yavāgū गाढ़ी लपसी, peyā पतली लपसी, kalka लुगदी (not लेई), jāṅgala यानी शुष्क प्रदेश के वन्य पशु.
